title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff + regional failover ordering
author: Maya Srinivasan
description: Urgent hotfix to address a race condition in the SLO enforcer backoff/hysteresis logic that caused cascading regional failovers and excessive load-shedding under bursty traffic. This PR tightens ordering guarantees in the enforcer state machine, adds a small randomized jitter to backoff timers to avoid thundering herd on recovery, and wires additional tracing and metrics so we can pinpoint policy transitions in production. Includes an immediate mitigation that prefers local fallbacks for compatible model variants before triggering cross-region failover. Checklist: [x] reproduce locally with stress harness, [x] unit tests for ordering, [x] integration test for graceful failover, [x] add tracing spans and metrics, [x] docs/ops note. Related: ENG-1987, ENG-2032. Motivation: during the incident on 2026-02-18 we observed overlapping backoff timers leading to out-of-order enforcer decisions which amplified downstream load-shedding. This patch prevents that by serializing critical state updates, introducing jitter, and improving observability to reduce MTTR.

release_notes: Hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering and regional failover behavior to prevent cascading load-shedding. Adds jitter to backoff timers, additional tracing and metrics, and a local fallback preference before cross-region failover.
review_comments: Ravi Patel (review): Found a race where two backoff timers could both observe candidate == current and both trigger region failover. Recommend serializing updates or using versioned CAS. Please add unit tests for ordering.

Maya Srinivasan (author): Thanks Ravi, serialized critical updates behind a lightweight single-writer lock and added version checks. Unit tests added in test/slo_enforcer_ordering_test.go. Also added jitter to timers to avoid simultaneous recoveries.
Tess O'Connor (review): Integration test reproduces the original failure scenario and passes with the fix. Can we also expose transition_count metric for alerting?
Maya Srinivasan (author): Added slo_enforcer.transition_count and slo_enforcer.backoff_reason tags. Updated dashboards and ops runbook with thresholds used during incident response.
Jordan Li (approval): Verified change locally with stress harness and reviewed telemetry. Approve.
Tess O'Connor (approval): Approve after confirming metrics and runbook updates.
